comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @participant2 Is there a known issue related to this one ?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Could you provide Minimal reproduce step ?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: @reporter Can you provide procedures to reproduce it ?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
1. create table t (col0 int, col1 int)
2. insert many data into t and ensure that all col1 are null
3. execute `select group_concat(col1) from t group by col0` and ensure that spill is triggered

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant2 I tried to reproduce this with a `tiup playground` to update which versions are affected, but I'm struggling to get it reproduced. It might somehow not use disk spill. Do you have some more detailed steps?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
> [@participant2](https://github.com/participant2) I tried to reproduce this with a `tiup playground` to update which versions are affected, but I'm struggling to get it reproduced. It might somehow not use disk spill. Do you have some more detailed steps?

1.
```
CREATE TABLE `agg_test` (
  `col_key` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `col0` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `col1` decimal(20,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col2` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `col3` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `col4` int DEFAULT NULL
);
```

2. insert 5 million rows and ensure that all col0 are null
3. execute the following sql `explain analyze select group_concat(col0), group_concat(col1), group_concat(col2), group_concat(col3), group_concat(col4) from agg_test group by col_key;` and ensure that spill is triggered

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> ... and ensure that spill is triggered

What's needed for that with `tiup playground`?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
> > ... and ensure that spill is triggered
> 
> What's needed for that with `tiup playground`?

You can check if disk usage is 0 in explain analyze information to know if spill has been triggered. If it's 0, you can lower the system variable `tidb_mem_quota_query` to make it easier to be triggered. However, I think you can successfully trigger the spill with `tidb_mem_quota_query`'s default value in my detailed steps.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant2 that together with increasing the total dataset to ~10M rows did the trick. Thanks!
